verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no training-use policy, no opt-out from model training, and no contractual no-training commitment for LangSmith. The only related item is that self-hosted LangSmith keeps trace data in your own environment, which is a data-residency control rather than a guarantee against training use, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
